title: SANDA
synopsis:
In a future where children are few and regarded as Japan's most valuable assets, Christmas has become a mere legend of the past. For the students of Daikoku Welfare Academy—a boarding school where they are educated, protected, and monitored—the mythical Santa Claus is a forgotten character of fiction. For the adults, Santa Claus is a very real menace that needs to be neutralized by the Saint Nick Pursuit Unit in case he makes an appearance.

Shiori Fuyumura, a student of Daikoku Welfare Academy, is determined to find her best friend, Ichie Ono, who has been declared dead after being missing for six months. One morning, Fuyumura summons her fellow class representative, Kazushige Sanda, only to attack the unknowing boy. She is convinced that Sanda is the descendant of the infamous Santa Claus—the only person who can make her wish of finding Ono come true—and is determined to force out his dormant true self by any means necessary.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

episodes.title: Everything's Bright, Am I Aging?
episodes.synopsis:
On a Dec 25 without Christmas, Sanda is attacked by classmate Shiori. Mistaking it for love, he awaits her confession, but hears something else.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Candies, Canes, Kisses, and Blades
episodes.synopsis:
Amaya learns Sanda is Santa, restrains him and Shiori to force a kiss. Santa refuses, unlocks sled power to escape. Then Headmaster Oshibu appears!

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Charred Fruit Tastes All the Sweeter
episodes.synopsis:
Sanda gains lie-detecting power. Shiori tries to use it to find Ono, but doubt overwhelms Sanda. Shiori then tells a self-harming lie.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Zeus, Smasher of Textbooks
episodes.synopsis:
At a funeral, Santa fights Yagiuda but fears his power. His resolve returns, shattering the roof and leaving him exposed before all.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: A Typhoon in a Snow Globe
episodes.synopsis:
Sanda vows never to love, but in a typhoon, his message to fiancée Niko fails, and he's drawn to her. The next day, Yagiuda arrives as a teacher.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Cyborg vs. Santa Claus
episodes.synopsis:
Santa blocks Headmaster Oshibu from attacking adult Ono, but the enhanced 92-year-old overpowers him. Santa asks the kids for their belief to fight.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Double-Faced Carnivorous Plant
episodes.synopsis:
Amaya ends his friendship with Sanda to save him. Meanwhile, the scarred Oshibu, comforted by Yagiuda, turns to Class 10 students who killed adults.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Love, the Most Selfish Thing There Is
episodes.synopsis:
Saved from Namatame by Shiori, Santa vows to harden his heart, but when Niko asks for a kiss, Sanda panics and almost transforms before her.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: A Fake Flower, Yet Its Roots Rot
episodes.synopsis:
Tetsudome says Santa lacks grit. With her aid, Sanda becomes dark Santa, but doubts himself. After meeting Namatame again, he vows not to fight kids.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: You, an Everlasting Moment
episodes.synopsis:
At the Peak of Youth Ceremony, Niko steals Sanda's first kiss at twilight. Meanwhile Yagiuda faces Namatame alone, offering himself as decoy.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Flashback Attack
episodes.synopsis:
Namatame wrecks the ceremony. Eating yakisoba, she's met by Sanda in child form. His body starts breaking down as Ono's own changes grow.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

episodes.title: Pale Blue Pall
episodes.synopsis:
Santa fights Oshibu before the students. The headmaster thrives on cheers, but Santa regains power by revealing his truth. The duel peaks on the roof.

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)
